Yes. Hansen mapped approximately **81.3 hectares** of tree-cover loss within the property in 2021, or **2.23%** of its 3,643.5 hectares. Most of the mapped loss area (68.1 hectares) was in planted forest.

A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event. Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation, a change in land use, or the cause of the loss.
